test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following plants is on the verge of extinction due to insensitivity to our environment?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Madhuca insignis.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Madhuca insignis** is a species of plant in the** family Sapotaceae. **
 
• It is aboriginal to India. It had been **declared extinct due to habitat loss.** 
 
• However, a **Madhuca insignis population **has been reborn along the riverside **Kumaradhara, in Dakshina Kannada region of Karnataka state, India.**
 
• The area is the advance site for the** Kukke I and Kukke II hydel power projects.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ee0f6ae068869245d59afa9662cc20f78cbcc9d545417a153cd2be8ba2baeed.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **R. damascena** is traditionally used for **treatment of abdominal and chest pains, strengthening the heart, menstrual bleeding, digestive problems and constipation**.
 
• The **common sunflower** is a large annual forb of the **genus Helianthus** grown as a crop for its edible oil and seeds.​ 
 
• **Bellis perennis,** the daisy, is a **European species of the family Asteraceae**, often considered the archetypal species of the name daisy.
